truf.summary_desc: Tactical Indonesian trick-taking card game. Standard 4 players (13 cards each, 52-card deck). Can also be played with 3 players (17 cards each, 1 card removed) or 5 players (10 cards each, 2 cards removed).
truf.players_variation_desc: Card distribution and trick count per round based on player count:
truf.var_3p: 3 Players: 17 cards per player. 1 card (2♣) is removed from the deck (total 51 cards & 17 tricks per round).
truf.var_4p: 4 Players (Standard): 13 cards per player (full 52-card deck & 13 tricks per round).
truf.var_5p: 5 Players: 10 cards per player. 2 cards (2♣ & 2♦) are removed from the deck (total 50 cards & 10 tricks per round).
truf.suits_desc: If the highest bid is tied, the trump suit is decided by the official Indonesian hierarchy:
truf.suit_5: No Truf 🚫 — No trump suit in play
truf.phase_1_desc: Players take turns clockwise calling their target tricks. Highest bidder determines the Truf suit.
truf.phase_2_desc: In practice, players announce their deviation ('Under X / Over Y / Made/Pas') relative to their bid. The app automatically calculates actual tricks won and verifies that the sum of tricks matches the total tricks for that round.
truf.bid13_desc: If total bids equal the exact number of tricks in hand (13 in 4p, 17 in 3p, 10 in 5p), the bid decider chooses: if Main Atas (High), all bids are decreased by 1 (-1). If Main Bawah (Low), all bids are increased by 1 (+1).
truf.mode_atas_desc: Aggressive scoring. Winning tricks is easier, but missing tricks incurs severe penalties (Lack Multiplier -2x).
truf.mode_bawah_desc: Defensive scoring. Players must avoid over-tricks; taking extra tricks incurs severe penalties (Excess Multiplier -2x).
truf.bid0_success: Bid 0 Success: Earns points equal to the highest bid in the round (or custom fixed bonus)
truf.bid0_fail: Bid 0 Fail: Penalty for excess tricks (Excess Multiplier)
truf.dealer_streak_rule: 10x Consecutive Dealer Rule: If a dealer holds dealer status 10 consecutive rounds without losing it, the game ends immediately.

remi.summary_desc: Classic Indonesian 7-card rummy for 2 to 6 players (standard 4). The objective is to form valid melds and close the table with minimal penalty points.
remi.meld_run_desc: At least 3 consecutive cards of the exact same suit (e.g., 7♠ - 8♠ - 9♠ or 10♥ - J♥ - Q♥ - K♥).
remi.meld_set_desc: 3 or 4 cards of the same rank in different suits (e.g., K♠ - K♥ - K♦ or 9♣ - 9♦ - 9♥).
remi.card_face: Face Cards (King, Queen, Jack): 10 Points each
remi.close_normal_desc: The round winner gets 0 penalty. All other players receive negative points equal to the total card values remaining in their hand.
remi.close_pure_desc: Closing the table in a single turn without previously opening melds. All opponents receive DOUBLE PENALTY (2x hand card values).
remi.elimination_desc: The match continues until a player reaches the penalty limit (e.g., -500 or -1000 points). The player with the lowest penalty score wins.

omben.summary_desc: Traditional Indonesian card-shedding game (Cangkulan) for 2–6 players. Players race to empty their hand to avoid the 'Omben' loser penalty.
omben.flow_lead: 1. Lead Card: First player plays any 1 card to the table.
omben.flow_follow: 2. Follow Suit: Subsequent players MUST follow the lead card's suit.
omben.flow_cangkul: 3. Drawing / Cangkul: If a player lacks the matching suit, they MUST draw cards one by one from the center stock pile until finding a match or pile is depleted.
omben.flow_win_trick: 4. Trick Winner: Highest card of the lead suit wins the trick and leads the next trick.
omben.rank_1st: 1st Place (Out / Winner): First player to empty all cards.
omben.rank_2nd_3rd: 2nd & 3rd Places: Players emptying cards in subsequent order.
omben.rank_omben: Kena 'Omben' (Round Loser): The last player remaining with cards when the round ends.
omben.tally_desc: The app tracks cumulative Omben losses. When a player reaches the agreed loss threshold (e.g., 5x Omben), they incur the social penalty / treat round!

chess.summary_desc: Split-screen 180° chess clock with official FIDE time controls for 2 face-to-face players.
chess.fischer_desc: Fischer Increment adds bonus seconds on every move tap.
